description: A single four-operator FM voice reduced to one operator of the Yamaha YM2612, with its own envelope and feedback

params.text: Sets how quickly the envelope climbs to the level set by TL, 1 to 31, higher settings taking longer
Sets the height the envelope climbs to, 0 to 100, with 100 the loudest
Sets how quickly the envelope falls from its peak to the sustain level, 0 to 31, higher settings taking longer
Sets the level the envelope falls to and holds while the gate stays high, 0 to 15, with 15 the loudest
Sets how quickly the envelope keeps falling once it has reached the sustain level, 0 to 31, higher settings taking longer
Sets how quickly the envelope falls to silence after the gate drops, 0 to 15, higher settings taking longer
Switched on, the envelope repeats instead of holding, turning it into a looping modulation source
Makes the envelope run faster at higher pitches, 0 to 3, with 0 applying no such scaling
Sets the pitch of the operator, five octaves either side of C4
Sets the rate of the chip's internal low frequency oscillator, from 3.98Hz to 72.2Hz in eight steps
Sets how far the internal low frequency oscillator moves the pitch, from nothing up to 80% of a semitone in eight steps
Sets how far the internal low frequency oscillator moves the level, in four steps from nothing to 11.8dB
Attenuates the voltage at the FM jack before it modulates the pitch, and inverts it below zero
Multiplies the operator frequency by a half, or by one to fifteen
Feeds the operator's own output back into its phase, 0 to 7, which turns the sine wave progressively into a saw

inputs.text: Raises the attack rate set by the AR slider, the full slider range spanning 8V
Raises the total level set by the TL slider, the full slider range spanning 8V
Raises the decay rate set by the DR slider, the full slider range spanning 8V
Raises the sustain level set by the SL slider, the full slider range spanning 8V
Raises the sustain rate set by the SR slider, the full slider range spanning 8V
Raises the release rate set by the RR slider, the full slider range spanning 8V
Opens the envelope while it is above 2V and releases it when it falls back to 0V
Restarts the envelope from its attack stage on each rise past 2V, without the gate having to fall first
Sets the pitch of the operator at a volt per octave, added to the FREQ knob and clamped to six and a half octaves either side of C4
Modulates the phase of the operator through the FM knob, ramping to full modulation at 5V
Scales the VOL knob by the voltage here, 10V leaving it untouched and 0V silencing the output

outputs.text: Carries the operator's audio, clipped at 5V

notes: the module makes no sound until a gate above 2V reaches the GATE jack; with nothing patched there the envelope never opens
a rise at RTRG while GATE is already high shuts the envelope for one sample and restarts it, which is what makes a re-trigger audible
menu: Soft Reset Envelope Generator — restarts the envelope from its present level rather than from zero, which removes the click at the start of a re-triggered note
